style: 16-bit pixel art game art, crisp hard-edged pixels, limited night palette: plum black, deep plum, violet glow, cream, sunset orange, warm orange and gold window lights, the career accent colour only on screens and small glows. Dusk City at night: a skyline made of lit window dots, a few still stars
suffix: no people, no faces, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no sunburst rays, no perspective floor grid, no scanlines, no grain, no glowing particles

assets.prompt: a dark office desk at night lit by one warm desk lamp, a thick open ledger book with rows of blank ruled lines, tall leaning stacks of paper receipts and invoices around it, a magnifying glass resting on one receipt that has a single small red flag pinned to it, a window onto the night city behind

the counter of a small bubble tea shop at night, plain unbranded cups with dark tapioca pearls lined up, a tablet standing on the counter with a soft lilac glowing screen showing blank rows of entries with small tick marks, a metal spike of paper receipts beside it, one receipt with a small red flag, the shop window looking onto the night city

an open orange portfolio folder on a desk at night holding a neat ledger page of blank ruled lines with small tick marks and a blank receipt clipped to it, a small plum metal cash box with a lilac ribbon, a short stack of cream and lilac index cards, no plants, a window showing a small cream university gate on a far hill under the moon

a bedroom desk at night, a laptop showing a spreadsheet grid of blank lilac cells with one cell glowing orange, a warm desk lamp, a small piggy bank, a phone lying screen down, a few loose blank paper receipts and plain unmarked coins, a small orange flag planted beside the laptop, the moon in the window

a hilltop path above the city just before sunrise, the path of glowing tiles splitting in two: the left branch ends at a giant magnifying glass leaning on a closed ledger book, the right branch ends at a small lit shop stall with a striped awning, a thin orange band of first light on the horizon
a vertical top-down game world map at night: five small dark islands in a deep plum sea, tiny lit windows on each island, no path, no labels
a chunky pixel picture frame, orchid outer border, orange corner studs, deep plum dithered interior with a few stars, empty centre
the PassionSeed flame logo as a pixel game host: yellow flame body, black face, big white eyes, holding a small mic, transparent background
the same flame host, mouth open mid-sentence, transparent background
the same flame host winking, transparent background
the same flame host, flame tips swayed one pixel, transparent background
the same flame host with eyes shut mid blink, transparent background
